# ThetaWave

> > ThetaWave is an AI-powered note-taking platform that transforms lectures into comprehensive study materials including notes, mind maps, quizzes, and flashcards for college students.

ThetaWave leverages artificial intelligence to enhance student learning and productivity by automatically converting lecture content into multiple study formats. The platform serves diverse student populations across different disciplines and learning modalities, including traditional college students, law students, and online learners.

## Core Features

- [AI Note Taker for College Students](https://thetawave.ai): ThetaWave AI note taker transforms lectures into notes, mindmaps, quizzes & flashcards
- [AI Mind Map Generator](https://thetawave.ai/zh-tw/features/mind-map-maker): ThetaWave mind map generator creates interactive visual learning diagrams from study materials

## Use Cases & Student Segments

- [AI Learning Tool for Law Students](https://thetawave.ai/zh/use-cases/for-law-students): ThetaWave AI learning tool for law students with case analysis and exam prep
- [AI Tools for Online Learners](https://thetawave.ai/it/use-cases/for-online-learners): ThetaWave AI tools for online learners with video summaries and study materials
